title: Fix Pack Table SoA Decode Losing Nested RecordSpec For Option Fields
description:
Confirmed upstream `pack` crate bug (not app-specific), discovered by the wave-2 architect-family agent while wiring PACK-BINARY-DOCUMENT-LAYER-ACROSS-ALL-APPS (see .repo/🎫/26/07/27/PACK-BINARY-DOCUMENT-LAYER-ACROSS-ALL-APPS/wave2-architect.txt §3, task_2decfb30).

Repro: `Program.stakeholders: Vec<Stakeholder>` is `#[dsl(table)]`. `Stakeholder.header: EntityHeader` is a plain nested `#[derive(dsl::DslRecord)]` field. `EntityHeader.description: Option<TextField>` is `None` in the sample fixture. `cargo test -p architect_program program::tests::sample_program_dsl_pack_equivalence` (currently `#[ignore]`d) panics with "pack decode failed: schema error: missing field 'description' at 1:1".

Root cause in pack/value/rs/lib.rs: `decode_table_soa`'s fallback branch (for non-primitive TableSoA columns, e.g. nested Record columns) calls `decode_value(reader, None, ctx, depth + 1)` — passing `shape: None` unconditionally, even when the caller (`decode_value`'s TAG_TABLE_SOA arm) actually has the field's `Shape::Table(spec_fn)` available via the outer call's `shape` parameter. With `shape: None`, `decode_value`'s TAG_RECORD arm resolves `record_spec_of(shape) == None`, so the nested `decode_record_fields` skips its own end-of-function backfill loop that inserts `Absent` for every spec field not seen on the wire. Meanwhile `encode_table`'s symmetric fallback correctly omits `Absent` fields from the wire (canonical-mode compaction). Net effect: the omitted field is never backfilled on decode.

This affects EVERY `#[dsl(table)]` field whose row type has a nested (non-Option) record field that itself has an `Option<T>` sub-field left at `None` — a common, idiomatic pattern.

Fix: thread the known column `Shape` into `decode_table_soa`'s fallback branch when the caller does have a `RecordSpec` for the table's element type (only `None` for genuinely unknown/unfamiliar table fields, preserving the self-describing unknown-field round-trip property). Add a regression test in pack/value/rs/lib.rs's own `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with exactly this shape (table row type with nested non-Option record field with an Option sub-field defaulted to None), confirm it round-trips. Then re-run `cargo test -p architect_program` — `sample_program_dsl_pack_equivalence` should un-ignore and go green with zero architect/** changes.

Do NOT touch architect/** — that family's wave-2 agent intentionally left this test `#[ignore]`d pending this upstream fix.
summary:
Fixed the confirmed upstream `pack` crate bug: `decode_table_soa`'s fallback (non-primitive) TableSoA column branch called `decode_value(reader, None, ...)` unconditionally, discarding the element `RecordSpec` even when the caller had one. For a nested `Record` column, this made `record_spec_of(shape)` resolve to `None`, so `decode_record_fields` skipped its end-of-function backfill loop that inserts `Absent` for spec fields not seen on the wire — meaning an `Option<T>` sub-field of a nested-record table column, left `None` and thus omitted by canonical-mode compaction on encode, was never reconstructed on decode, producing a "missing field" error downstream (e.g. `dsl_derive`'s generated `from_record`).

Fix: `decode_value`'s `TAG_TABLE_SOA` arm now passes `table_spec_of(shape)` into `decode_table_soa`; `decode_table_soa` resolves the element `RecordSpec` once (`spec_fn.map(|f| f())`) and threads the resolved field's `Shape` into `decode_value` for its fallback-column branch, so nested records backfill correctly. Falls back to `None` exactly as before for genuinely unknown/unfamiliar table fields, preserving the self-describing unknown-field round-trip guarantee.

Added a regression test, `table_soa_nested_record_column_backfills_absent_option_subfield`, in pack/value/rs/lib.rs's own `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (plus its `header_spec`/`table_row_with_nested_record_spec` fixtures), reproducing exactly the reported shape. All 13 pack_value tests pass (12 pre-existing + this one; a 13th, `table_soa_tuple_column_round_trips_as_tuple_not_list`, landed concurrently from another session fixing a related tuple-column issue in the same fallback branch — verified compatible, no conflict).

Verified `architect_program::program::tests::sample_program_dsl_pack_equivalence` (previously `#[ignore]`d pending this fix) now passes — confirmed both via `--ignored` before a concurrent session un-ignored it, and again as a normal test after. Did not touch architect/** myself per the ticket's explicit instruction; that file's `#[ignore]` removal was landed by another concurrent session. `cargo check -p pack_value -p pack_format -p pack_core -p vcs -p dsl_derive -p architect_program`: clean, no new warnings. `cargo test -p architect_program --lib`: 180 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (unrelated pre-existing ignore).
